description: With cas.first_data_timeout_ms unset, the Called node's first-data wait covers the transmissions one largest DATA C_PDU needs on the slowest ladder rung, one answer wait each, when that is more than three.
note: Flow as cas-make-called-first-data-timeout up to the link being made, with cas.first_data_timeout_ms unset and a drc.table, and the run ends once the link's timers have started. At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10), a type 8 D_PDU carrying a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with the Ed4 bit set, which records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (B-0408); the CAS answers PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED, sent at 52000 after the contention wait of 45000 (seed 0, slot 15), at drc.default_speed WN 2 Long since 0.0.1.3 has sent no recommendation. The table's thresholds list is empty, so the burst at 1000 to 3000 gives no estimate and 0.0.1.3, heard and recorded Ed4, is owed MAX-SEGMENT alone, 0xAFF (value 255 to a sender that has sent no SENDER-APPROACH; interp C-1271, C-1272), and no top priority. With a calibrated table this node sends its SENDER-APPROACH, 0xB04, first in a transmission that carries data to the peer, here the type 8 D_PDU (interp C-1286), so the accept carries 0xB04 in place of the template's CAPABILITY 0xF01; that D_PDU differs only in its EOW and header CRC. The link is made at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts (B-0215, B-0216), then the SIS soft link timers, unset and so derived from the answer wait: minimum hold and idle three answer waits, maximum six (A-0321). The derived first-data wait (interp B-0420, revised corpus 0.33.0; corpus-format.md section 6): n answer waits, n the larger of 3 and ceil(2054 / c), where 2054 bytes is the largest DATA C_PDU (1-octet C_PCI, B-0111; 5-octet S_PCI with a TTD, A-0160; a 2048-byte U_PDU at the MTU, A-0047) and c the bytes one transmission of the configured length carries on the ladder's slowest rung, ladder[0]: b = floor((min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) - preamble_ms - flush_ms) / block_ms) blocks, at least 1, so c = b x block_bytes - modem.eom_bytes (C-0551, C-1042, C-1290). The answer wait is the derived dts.ack_wait (C-1120): min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) + max(lbt_wait_dcd_ms, lbt_wait_vdcd_ms) + num_cont_slots x cont_slot_width_ms. Here dts.max_transmission_ms is 30000 and the ladder is WN 1 Long then WN 2 Long, with a fixture entry for WN 1 Long of 50 bytes and 9600 ms a block. The answer wait is 30000 + 30000 + 16 x 3000 = 108000. On WN 1 Long b = floor((30000 - 600 - 150) / 9600) = 3, c = 3 x 50 - 0 = 150, and ceil(2054 / 150) = 14 (13 x 150 = 1950 is short), so cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts with 14 x 108000 = 1512000 (before corpus 0.33.0, three answer waits, 324000). The soft link minimum hold and idle start with 324000 and the maximum with 648000. The accept transmission lasts 5550 ms, inside the 30000 limit, so nothing before the link is made changes.
